name: hr-id-card-automata
description: Progressive Web App to generate HR ID cards from employee data. Local-first, template-driven, exportable to PDF and DOCX. Features a drag-and-drop template designer with layer-based editing, touch controls, rotation support, undo/redo, glassmorphism/gradient design tools, toast notifications, template library, cookie consent, and SEO optimization.
majorCapabilities: Drag-and-drop visual template designer with text, image, shape, and barcode layers
Canvas-based layer editing with snap-to-grid, icon-based resize/rotate handles (larger for touch), and property inspector
Undo/redo history stack (50 steps) for template editing with keyboard shortcuts
Gradient backgrounds (linear/radial) for text, shape, and image layers with color pickers
Glassmorphism effects (blur + opacity) for text, shape, and image layers
Border styles (solid/dashed/dotted) with color pickers for text, shape, and image layers
Touch-enabled controls for drag, resize, and rotate via unified pointer events
Front/back dual-sided template support with side toggle
Responsive canvas with auto-scaling zoom and mobile-friendly layout
Template library with save, load, rename, delete, export/import JSON
Toast notification system for save, load, import, and export actions
Import templates from image files (PNG/JPG) as tracing backgrounds
Dynamic SEO meta tag injection (Open Graph, Twitter Cards, JSON-LD)
Full backward compatibility with legacy CardConfig template format
Rotation property in layout panel for element positioning
